def solve(p, n):
    g = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(0, p+1):
        if 0 <= p-r < n: g[r][p-r] = 2
        if 0 <= p+r < n: g[r][p+r] = 2
    for r in range(0, p+1, 2):
        rr, cc = r+1, p-r+1
        if cc - rr == p:  # coincides with right 2-ray
            continue
        while rr < n:
            if 0 <= cc < n: g[rr][cc] = 1
            if cc >= n: break
            rr += 1; cc += 1
    return g
